desc: 四层复合布层加宽软包边，浅冰蓝无印花平面褶皱，细圆耳带日常佩戴
leaf: 一次性浅冰蓝四层复合宽软包边平面褶皱口罩
name: 浅冰蓝四层宽软包边褶皱口罩款

shots.intent: 首屏用深天蓝标题带压燕麦纸底立住清爽中性第一印象，一眼看清浅冰蓝四层宽软包边平面口罩本体结构。
shots.textZone: headline in near-white inside the blue band, one sub-line on the oat field, three bare silhouette labels beneath

shots.intent: 用六格日常环境把浮尘、飞絮、尾气和油烟讲成戴口罩的理由，只呈现可见的颗粒物，完全不碰病理叙事。
shots.textZone: headline on the oat field, one short label under each of the six tiles, no body text

shots.intent: 高机位把四层布片拆成等距斜列并配单向箭头流，让买家看懂每一层是什么布、气流怎么走，全部数值留白。
shots.textZone: headline top-left, four ordinal numerals plus four material labels down the right column

shots.intent: 用一枚四象限环形图把四个佩戴与用料优点一次讲清，中心只放产品与留白资质带，不写任何数值与机构名。
shots.textZone: blue band headline, four quadrant labels, one blank verification strip with an empty interior

shots.intent: 仰角拍侧面，用一升一降两组箭头阵讲清织物透气与干爽体感，把舒适度画成可见的气流方向。
shots.textZone: headline in the upper-left clean corner plus one short label in a lower corner

shots.intent: 上下两张实色与浅底对分卡加序号大字，等比对照单层薄布与四层复合本体的挺度与层次，把用料差讲成看得见的差别。
shots.textZone: one large ordinal numeral and one header plus two short labels per card

shots.intent: 微距串看宽软包边、白色鼻夹条与细圆耳带焊点三处做工，直接回应开边、滑落与勒耳三大疑虑。
shots.textZone: three short labels in a lower corner, one per detail zone

shots.intent: 把产品放回真实户外通风场景，人物背向只露后脑与肩线，让日常佩戴人群产生代入而不出现任何医疗形象。
shots.textZone: clean upper zone for one headline plus one short line

shots.intent: 90 度俯视摊开整叠、单只独立包装与展开本体三种形态，帮买家一次判断装形态、尺寸比例与立体层次。
shots.textZone: three short labels along the bottom near-white panel

shots.intent: 用四条佩戴与存放须知加一枚短按钮收口全页，靠结构与佩戴提醒完成加购，不靠任何资质或数值承诺。
shots.textZone: blue band headline, four short reminder lines on the near-white panel, one rounded azure button above the footer band

style.backgroundSystem: banded screens: one solid deep sky-blue #2E76BE title band along the top or bottom edge alternating with a fleck-grained oat paper field #EFEAE0 carrying fine dark speckle tooth; on the oat field sits one raised near-white panel #F7F5F1 framed by a thin #2E76BE hairline with a single soft offset shadow falling to the lower-right; one pale mist-blue tint #D7E7F4 reserved for diagram plates and the negative example column; a bare leaf-green #47A06E foliage sprig is the only organic prop; never a blue gradient field, never a stepped 3D plinth, never a pastel candy colour block, never a grey sticker-card collage, never a clinical or tiled space
style.iconSystem: bare flat two-tone silhouette glyphs in deep sky-blue #2E76BE with one near-white #F7F5F1 knockout detail, seated directly on the field with no container shape at all, never a thin-line outline circle, never a filled disc inside an arch-topped card, never a solid rounded-square badge; recurring motif is a plain shield silhouette with a knockout tick, identical proportion and knockout weight everywhere; arrow components are solid flat chevrons in #2E76BE, near-white #F7F5F1 or deep petrol-navy #123A5C
style.lightingSystem: neutral 5600K studio light, broad front-left key with a low ambient fill, long even soft shadows always falling to the lower-right, no light streak, no diagonal glare band, no specular hotspot, no coloured rim glow, identical direction across the whole set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh-air neutral band-and-panel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep sky-blue band #2E76BE, fleck-grained oat paper field #EFEAE0, raised near-white info panel #F7F5F1, one pale mist-blue diagram tint #D7E7F4, deep petrol-navy text #123A5C, and one fresh leaf-green accent #47A06E; neutral 5600K studio light with a broad front-left key, a low ambient fill and long even soft shadows falling to the lower-right, no light streak and no specular hotspot; banded screens alternating a solid #2E76BE title band with a flecked oat #EFEAE0 field carrying one raised near-white #F7F5F1 panel framed by a thin #2E76BE hairline; one diagram per screen drawn from a fixed component set, namely a four-quadrant ring diagram, isometric material plates with one-way arrow flow, opposing breath arrow fans, and alternating solid-and-tint split cards carrying one large ordinal numeral; one humanist Chinese sans only, no letterspaced Latin kicker and no rotated vertical Latin label; bare flat two-tone silhouette glyphs in #2E76BE with one #F7F5F1 knockout detail and no container shape at all, never a thin-line circle, never a filled disc in an arch-topped card and never a solid rounded-square badge; one leaf-green #47A06E foliage sprig as the only organic prop; the pale ice-blue #DCE8EF four-layer flat pleated mask keeps its three horizontal pleats, its white #FFFFFF nose-clip band with one hidden wire, its wide soft-bound pale #C9DCE8 edge binding, its thin round white #F7F9FA elastic ear loops and its separately visible near-white #F5F8FA inner liner sheet, with no print, no pattern and no logo; stable product scale, angle and centring; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no percentage or grade code rendered, no medical or clinical framing.
noDrift: no color palette changes
no mixed fonts
no random backgrounds
no inconsistent lighting
no mismatched icon styles
no blue gradient field and no stepped 3D plinth; the ground is a solid azure band over a flecked oat paper field
no pastel candy colour-block boards, no pink, no mint, no scalloped edging, no rounded arch-topped cards
no cool grey editorial sticker-card collage and no slate blue-grey panel blocks
no warm 4300K front-right key, no 6000K top-left light streak and no 5200K top-right key; the set is neutral 5600K with a broad front-left key
no thin-line outline circle icons, no filled disc icons in arch-topped cards and no solid rounded-square badges; icons stay bare two-tone silhouettes with no container
no letterspaced Latin kicker line and no rotated vertical Latin section label; secondary copy stays Chinese
no filtration percentage of any kind, including 95 or 99 style figures, and no BFE or PFE value
no micron or particle-size figure and no absorption, adsorption or breathability efficiency figure
no pathogen, virus, bacteria, germ or disease claim and no antibacterial, antiviral or allergen-free wording
no infection, symptom or lung-protection wording of any kind
no medical, surgical, clinical or isolation wording anywhere, including the reference page artwork
no standard or grade code such as KN95, N95, GB 2626, YY 0469 or EN 14683
no test report, laboratory figure, certification mark, seal, framed document or authority letterhead
no clinical setting, hospital, clinic, surgical cap, scrubs or healthcare worker
no identifiable human face; any wearer is cropped above the jaw or turned away
no QR code, membership badge, contact block, price figure or discount chip
no printed pattern, cartoon motif or brand wordmark added to the mask body
no altered pleat count, nose-clip shape, ear-loop construction, soft edge binding, layer count, cup form or colour
style.presentationRules: keep the flat rectangular four-layer body, the three horizontal pleats, the white #FFFFFF nose-clip band across the top hem with one hidden wire, the wide soft-bound pale #C9DCE8 edge binding running around all four sides, the thin round white #F7F9FA elastic ear loops, the separately visible near-white #F5F8FA inner liner sheet and the pale ice-blue #DCE8EF face colour exactly as in the reference; no print, no pattern, no logo on the body; identical angle family, scale and centring in every shot
style.surfaceSystem: matte flecked oat paper panels #EFEAE0 with a real recycled-paper tooth, raised matte near-white info panels #F7F5F1, solid matte deep sky-blue #2E76BE band blocks, one pale mist-blue tint plate #D7E7F4 under diagrams, matte leaf-green #47A06E foliage sprig; real spun-bonded non-woven fabric texture on the product itself
style.typography: one humanist Chinese sans with a medium stroke weight throughout; three-layer in-image copy wrapped in 「」, headline at most 15 chars in deep petrol-navy #123A5C or near-white #F7F5F1 depending on the band underneath, two to six short labels, one large ordinal numeral per comparison card, no dense body text, no digits rendered by the model, no letterspaced Latin kicker line and no rotated vertical Latin section label
